steps.label: capture root container pre-probe
steps.expect: zero exit; capture the root listing as the blast-radius reference

steps.label: dpaiop create refused on AIOP-less silicon (DPAIOP-I1/I2)
steps.expect: refused: nonzero exit, dpaiop.0 absent; record the MC status

steps.label: contingency: destroy an unexpectedly created dpaiop
steps.expect: skip (s) if the create was refused; else remove dpaiop.0

steps.label: AIOP-flagged dprc create — is the option bit refused?
steps.expect: exit any; hypothesis dprc.2 created (only dpaiop create is gated), else absent is the finding

steps.label: contingency: destroy the AIOP-flagged dprc
steps.expect: skip (s) if the create above was refused; else destroy dprc.2

steps.label: capture root container post-probe
steps.expect: zero exit; matches the pre-probe capture, dpaiop.0 absent (no residue)
